lines: Ravikumar Krishnamurthi (Promoter Group) holds shares worth an estimated ₹2.03 crore at offer price, not sold in this offer; the amount is an estimate, and confidence is medium.
The holding is locked in for six months from the date of Allotment, so a call now is timely for discussing that lock-in period and what it means for planning.
The amount was found in one section only (promoter_holding) and is not in the seller table, so the proceeds and gain are not applicable.
